name: fortitool
description: Fortinet firmware tooling by Ali Mosajjal - fortitool for supported FortiGate/FortiWiFi firmware and FortiAnalyzer/FortiManager KVM installation packages.

plugins.name: fortitool
plugins.description: Decrypt and unpack supported FortiGate/FortiWiFi firmware and FAZ/FMG KVM disks, with automatic format/crypto detection. Also inspect FortiGuard PKCS#7 signatures and decrypt FortiOS config secrets. One static Go binary, no runtime OS packages.
